name: windows-v130-social-collector-and-smart-dedup
title: Windows Parity Handoff (v1.3.0): 6-Platform Social Media Batch Collector Bridge & Non-AI All-Media Smart Deduplication
description: Mirror macOS v1.3.0 capabilities in Windows Rust Core + Tauri + React UI: (1) extend local extension bridge with mediaCanonicalKeys separation, unified socialMedia/tweetMedia batch ingestion across X, Pixiv, Bluesky, Threads, Instagram, and Xiaohongshu with host-aware CDN Referer headers (Pixiv i.pximg.net, Instagram/Threads, Xiaohongshu), plus pixiv/instagram SocialPlatform variants; (2) implement pure classical non-AI smart deduplication covering all 8 MediaKinds with bucket isolation, local fingerprint cache, quality ranking, lossless metadata & Moodboard reference merging, and a Fluent 2 review modal with 5 entrypoints.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Pair with .trellis/tasks/11-25-windows-eaglepack-library-importer/ when shipping Windows v1.3.0. Shared browser extension Resources/BrowserExtension/ is already v1.3.0. Keep Windows edits strictly inside windows/.
